about: Pinned toolchain of the release: fetch_toolchain.py downloads each entry, checks its SHA-256 and unpacks it under work/release/toolchain-cache/trees/<name>/. '{version}' in a URL is the entry's own field. sha256 TO-FILL = never fetched (fetch_toolchain.py --fill records it); pin TO-CONFIRM = version not checked against the release page yet. Versions follow the Killzone 3 port's toolchain.json (same author) where it pins the same tool. The launcher is built with llvm-mingw, SDL3's devel package, CMake and Ninja (release.yml). What players get (launcher phase 4, pack_zip.py): the bare launcher zip carries SDL3.dll and the Python embeddable package; the full build zip also carries the build kit, whose toolchain/ is the entries with a 'kit' block (llvm-mingw, CMake, Ninja: unmodified, the listed 'prune' patterns left out) and licenses/ the files of the entries with 'kit_license' (their licence texts, as published). llvm-mingw-linux is CI only and never ships.
